annotations.title: Australian income tax and refund estimate

description: Australian income tax for a whole financial year and the likely refund or bill: tax at resident or foreign rates, low income tax offset, seniors and pensioners tax offset, Medicare levy with low-income and family reductions, Medicare levy surcharge and compulsory HELP/study loan repayments, compared with the tax withheld. Applies the $1,000 standard deduction for work-related expenses from 2026-27 and the working Australians tax offset (up to $250) from 2027-28. Use it for tax return estimates and questions involving deductions, other income, overtime, bonuses, couples and families, seniors or private health cover. For per-pay take-home figures use take_home_pay. Supports 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28 (an estimate with no refund). estimatedRefund is positive for a refund and negative for a bill. AUD. Read-only and deterministic.

deductions.description: Work-related expenses the person would itemise (AUD). From 2026-27 residents with work income get at least the $1,000 standard deduction, so amounts up to $1,000 don't change the result.

family.description: Spouse and dependent children, for the Medicare levy family reduction and surcharge thresholds.

foreignResident.description: Foreign resident for tax purposes. Default false.

otherDeductions.description: Deductions not covered by the standard deduction, such as gifts to charity and tax agent fees (AUD).

otherIncome.description: Other taxable income with no tax withheld, e.g. interest (AUD).

payFrequency.description: How often the salary is paid, for tax withheld. Default fortnightly.

privateHospitalCover.description: Has private patient hospital cover all year. Default true (no Medicare levy surcharge).

salary.description: Salary or wages for the year from one employer (AUD), excluding super, overtime and bonuses.

salaryIncludesSuper.description: salary is a package including the 12% super guarantee.

sapto.description: Eligible for the seniors and pensioners tax offset, with this status.

studyLoan.description: Has a HELP, VSL, SSL or other study and training support loan. Default false.

taxFreeThreshold.description: Tax-free threshold claimed with this employer. Default true (main job). Use false for a second job.

tfnProvided.description: Employee gave their tax file number. Default true. False applies the no-TFN rate.
